nodes.title: Pick up where the last session left off
nodes.label: CookbookRecipe

properties.title: Pick up where the last session left off
properties.summary: Turn chat messages into facts and decisions in a graph, and let a later session recall them from a blank prompt. When a decision changes, the new one replaces the old one but keeps its history, so the agent knows both what's true now and what it used to be.

properties.title: Agent memory
properties.capability: A durable store the agent's process opens itself, with uniqueness constraints and `MERGE` for one node per entity, `SUPERSEDES` chains for corrections, and vector `SEARCH` for recall.
properties.problem: Give an agent memory that survives restarts, which a later session can recall by meaning and by connection.

properties.title: Graph queries over MCP
properties.capability: `relate serve --mcp stdio` on a store opened `--read-only`, which lists the `read_cypher` and `get_schema` tools and leaves out `write_cypher`.
properties.problem: Give a coding agent or an agent framework a graph it can query through MCP, without letting it change the data.

properties.title: Single-file graph
properties.capability: The `.rl` store: one file holding the snapshot and the write-ahead log, created on the first open, compacted by `relate clone`, and read into memory with `--load`.
properties.problem: Keep a whole graph in one file that can be copied, attached, checked in or handed to another program.

properties.title: Hybrid retrieval for RAG
properties.capability: Vector and full-text indexes queried with the `SEARCH` clause, fused by reciprocal rank in one Cypher statement, with a graph hop from each hit to its related nodes.
properties.problem: Retrieve the passages that answer a question by meaning and by keyword at once, then follow links to the context around them.

properties.title: Tool-call provenance
properties.capability: Each tool call recorded as a node in the same graph, by the same statement as the call, linked to every node it wrote or returned and guarded by `NODE KEY` and relationship property constraints.
properties.problem: Find out which tool call wrote a fact in an agent's memory, which calls read it since, and what failed calls left behind.

properties.title: Codebase context graph
properties.capability: Crates, design records and their sections as one graph, IDF-weighted full-text `SEARCH` to find where to start, and bounded quantified path patterns to follow the links.
properties.problem: Give a coding agent answers to multi-hop questions about a codebase, such as what replaced a design decision or what builds on a module.

properties.title: Offline and sandboxed use
properties.capability: A single binary that needs no network once installed with usage metrics off (`DO_NOT_TRACK=1`), stores that are files in the workspace, and network access visible on the command line.
properties.problem: Run a graph database where an agent works isolated, with no network after setup and nothing sent anywhere.

properties.title: Diffable memory
properties.capability: A directory store whose checkpoint writes the graph as text, one `graph.json` with the `json` codec or one note per node with `markdown`, and `MERGE` writes that replay to no change.
properties.problem: Keep an agent's memory in the repository, so each session's changes show up in a pull request as a diff a person can review.

properties.title: Audit where an agent's memories came from
properties.summary: Write every memory tool call into the same graph as the memory, linked to everything it wrote or read. When a memory looks wrong, you can find the call that wrote it, who has read it since, what failed calls left behind, and what each tool costs.

properties.short: Append-only log each commit goes to before it applies; under the default `full` durability mode it is synced first, so a crash loses no acknowledged write.
A structure the planner uses to find nodes or relationships by a property without scanning a label: range, text, point, vector or full-text.
The Model Context Protocol, which agent hosts use to call tools; `relate serve --mcp` exposes a store as `read_cypher`, `get_schema` and `write_cypher`.

scenarios.title: Walk 1: Bounded Exploration -> CANDIDATE
scenarios.question: Which CLI flag enforces safe read-only access when connecting an agent memory store over MCP?
scenarios.summary: No shortcut exists yet. The bounded cursor inspects only real outgoing edges in Relate, walks 3 verified hops, and records a CANDIDATE shortcut (walk_count = 1/2).

steps.headline: Start bounded walk at Agent memory
steps.detail: Cursor opens session at `Capability:agent-memory` (`max_hops=8`). Zero shortcuts exist yet; Relate lists 21 verified outgoing relationships.

steps.headline: Hop 1 (CITES) -> Give an agent a memory
steps.detail: Cursor verifies `relate-docs:824a26e5a49c224e21f2fdef9421b9c707ecd543a067cd970c00eb8ef30a5682:0` was offered by the latest inspection and advances to `Page:get-started/agent-memory`.

steps.headline: Hop 3 (DOCUMENTS) -> --read-only
steps.detail: Cursor reaches `Flag:read-only` (`--read-only`) via `relate-docs:a04325346c57d70f5d5270e13252ea83a6aaeed84c324ed49c141d1139710d64:0` in 3 verified hops.

steps.headline: Record CANDIDATE with SHA-256 Evidence Receipt
steps.detail: Waygraph hashes all 3 ordered edge IDs, endpoints, types, and semantic properties into fingerprint `c34c45f3dbe1a205…`. Status is `CANDIDATE` (`walk_count=1`, threshold=2).

scenarios.title: Walk 2: Independent Verification -> VALID
scenarios.question: Which CLI flag enforces safe read-only access when connecting an agent memory store over MCP?
scenarios.summary: A second independent session traverses the same 3-hop route with a fresh walk_id. Matching SHA-256 evidence promotes the CANDIDATE into a golden VALID Desire Path.

steps.headline: Second session starts at Agent memory
steps.detail: Shortcut `96d05698a30a…` is still `CANDIDATE` (`walk_count=1`), so `inspect_walk` does NOT offer it yet — preventing one-off flukes from becoming shortcuts.

steps.headline: Re-verify 3-hop walk to --read-only
steps.detail: Independent `walk_id` traverses `Capability:agent-memory -> Page:get-started/agent-memory -> Page:guides/agents/connect-over-mcp -> Flag:read-only` across all 3 live edges.

steps.headline: Promoted to VALID Desire Path!
steps.detail: Live SHA-256 `c34c45f3dbe1a205…` matches Walk 1's fingerprint with a distinct `observation_id`. Relate promotes `:DPShortcut` `96d05698a30a…` to `VALID` (`walk_count=2`).

scenarios.title: Walk 3: 1-Step Shortcut Jump + SHA-256 Receipt
scenarios.question: Which CLI flag enforces safe read-only access when connecting an agent memory store over MCP?
scenarios.summary: On subsequent queries from Agent memory, the cursor offers the VALID desire path immediately. `take_shortcut` re-verifies all 3 edges in Relate and compresses 3 hops into 1 cursor step.

steps.headline: Cursor offers promoted shortcut at Agent memory
1-Step Jump -> --read-only (3 Hops Compressed!)
steps.detail: Relate re-reads all 3 evidence edges, confirms SHA-256 `c34c45f3dbe1a205…`, increments `reuse_count=2`, and advances cursor directly to `Flag:read-only` in 1 step.

scenarios.title: Edge Mutation -> STALE Rejection + Live Reroute
scenarios.question: Which CLI flag enforces safe read-only access when connecting an agent memory store over MCP?
scenarios.summary: An underlying relationship is disabled or semantically mutated. `take_shortcut` detects the dependency mismatch fail-closed (`SHORTCUT_STALE`), marks the shortcut STALE, and reroutes live.

steps.headline: Underlying edge mutated: Give an agent a memory -> Connect over MCP
steps.detail: Dependency #2 (`relate-docs:9fcf760d700818fc…`) is disabled / updated (`role='deprecated_mcp_link'`). Live path hash shifts to `f36dc5ce4a7ab9c0…` != stored `c34c45f3dbe1a205…`.

steps.headline: Fail-Closed Rejection: SHORTCUT_STALE (DEPENDENCY_INACTIVE)
steps.detail: `take_shortcut('96d05698a30a…')` re-verifies every dependency before moving the cursor, catches the broken link, updates `:DPShortcut.status = 'STALE'`, and raises `SHORTCUT_STALE`.

steps.headline: Live Reroute Hop 1 (CITES) -> Model agent memory
steps.detail: Refusing stale cache, the cursor inspects live neighbors of `Capability:agent-memory` and follows `relate-docs:4e4eb141c58544fc…` to `Page:guides/agents/model-agent-memory`.

steps.headline: Live Reroute Hop 2 (DOCUMENTS) -> --read-only (Recovered!)
steps.detail: Cursor follows `relate-docs:faf2c2d4dae0d906…` (`DOCUMENTS`) to `Flag:read-only`, answering accurately from live Relate ground truth with zero stale hallucination.
